title: Chapter 10: Job Shadowing the Mission Commander — A Day in the Life of Holly on Caelum-IV (Stardate 49604.2)
summary: Realizing that even 1,200 light-years from Blacksburg their youngest sister is still working a 16-hour shift advancing an entire exoplanet so the four musicians can explore in peace, Ryan, Cassidy, Evan, and Tyler spend Orbit Four job-shadowing Holly from shipboard telemetry and field biospheric assays to her silent Protocol T-10 clock.
